slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total cost of the tables ordered, subject to the total being between 150 and 600 tables?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total cost, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any conditional requirement linking Supplier A orders to a minimum number of tables from Supplier B.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether ordering from Supplier B requires also ordering from Supplier C.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no requirement that ordering from Supplier A forces ordering at least 30 tables from Supplier B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the A-to-B conditional constraint, but in READY_TO_MODEL stated there are no other constraints and modeled A and B as independent.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no requirement that ordering from Supplier B implies ordering from Supplier C.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the B-to-C conditional constraint, but in READY_TO_MODEL stated there are no other constraints and modeled B and C as independent.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without asking about either P1 conditional supplier-link constraint, leaving H2 and H3 unresolved.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective and basic bounds, but stopped prematurely without probing the two conditional supplier-link constraints, silently assuming A/B and B/C orders are independent.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
